advisory.finding: The widened `except (RuntimeError, ValueError, urllib.error.HTTPError, JiraAPIError)` catches `RetryExhaustedError` (a `RuntimeError` subclass) raised by `_call_with_retry` when a genuinely transient 5xx/429/timeout failure exhausts its retries. `_is_non_transition_http_error` returns False for it (it is neither `urllib.error.HTTPError` nor `JiraAPIError`), so a real infrastructure outage is now routed into the replay/comment-fallback/drift path instead of propagating as it did pre-S6.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Narrow `_HOP_REJECTIONS` (or re-raise `RetryExhaustedError`/non-rejection RuntimeErrors) so replay only treats true workflow rejections as hop aborts.

advisory.finding: `replay_transition` treats bare `RuntimeError` and `ValueError` as hop rejections via `_HOP_REJECTIONS`, so any incidental `RuntimeError`/`ValueError` (e.g. a `RetryExhaustedError`, a KeyError-wrapped bug, or a programming error) raised inside `transition_issue_by_name` during the walk is silently swallowed as a 'rejected hop' and converted to abort→drift, hiding a genuine fault.
